assertion.statement: Every geometric endomorphism of W0 acts faithfully on the full integral lattice Lambda of W0(C); hence End(W0_Qbar) embeds in End_Z(Lambda), a free group of rank(2g)^2.
assertion.objects: The actual Weil restriction W0=Res_K/Q A of dimension g and its complex analytic lattice Lambda.
assertion.hypotheses: W0 is the actual abelian variety; an embedding Qbar into C is fixed. Algebraic endomorphisms induce zero-preserving holomorphic maps.
assertion.quantifiers: Every geometric endomorphism of this W0.
assertion.uniformity: Natural for each pair of tori and map.
assertion.normalizations: Covariant action on the integral uniformization lattice.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Field of definition of a finite basis and ramification of its kernel field remain separate.
assertion.limit_order: Construct W0, pass to its analytic torus, inject endomorphisms into lattice matrices, then bound rank.

use.reason: The unique complex-linear lift is determined by its values on the full lattice, which spans the universal cover over R. Therefore a zero lattice action implies a zero endomorphism; a subgroup of the finite-rank free matrix group is free with the stated rank bound.

supplier.statement: A zero-preserving holomorphic map between complex tori lifts uniquely to a complex-linear map of universal covers carrying the source lattice into the target lattice.

publication.title: Introduction to Shimura varieties
publication.corrections: Exact original2005 published proof read in the retained independent source review; no family or arithmetic descent assertion.
